scope: Research only; archive retained unchanged, headers and row counts inspected. No figure or numerical data newly embedded.
assessment: Four individual Charon visit spectra 004/005/103/106 and grand-average are labelled separately from New Horizons comparison spectra and spectral models.

Supplementary Figure 4 filenames all contain Charon, but file b header explicitly targets Pluto contamination. Do not assign that spectrum to Charon; a is visit103 before correction and c is after correction.
Archive includes Europa comparison and laboratory compounds. These are not Charon local measurements or body skins.
Disk-integrated spectra and model I/F are not a natural-colour image, calibrated scene photometry, a geography map or direct local fractions.
Source-data files do not establish correct camera/range/product association for the inconsistent NASA natural-colour caption. MAST raw/calibrated product and extraction audit remain open.
terms: Current parent publisher article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not CC BY; third-party exceptions and laboratory source references retained. No automatic relicensing of every archive member and no derivative/figure embedding.
